is_mechanically_checkable.instructions: `sentence` is one rule from a Japanese rule document that an AI agent writes for itself and follows later. Decide whether a separate checker, given only the texts, files and command results the agent produced, could decide mechanically both whether this rule applies and whether it was followed, without relying on the agent's own feelings, intentions, wishes, sense of importance, or its judgment of similarity, abstraction level, essence, category or generality.

criteria.true: Every condition and every target in the rule can be checked on produced artifacts: named files or paths, named words or forms, counts, fixed lists, formats, positions.
criteria.false: Applying or checking the rule needs a judgment call by the agent: what counts as the same type, the right level of abstraction, what is essential or important, what the agent wants to avoid, whether something is possible, which category a rule belongs to, or what generalizes beyond one task.
